name: Yotpo
description: Yotpo is an ecommerce retention platform for product and site reviews, visual user-generated content, loyalty, referrals, SMS, email, customer insights, and product catalogs.
agentUseSummary: Yotpo cannot yet be connected through Relay. Its merchant APIs use a customer's Store ID and administrator-only API secret to mint broad account tokens, while public CDN review endpoints do not establish an account-owned connection; representative credential, entitlement, and authority acceptance is required.

credentialRequirements.name: YOTPO_STORE_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Yotpo Store ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Customer Store ID, formerly called the App Key.

credentialRequirements.name: YOTPO_API_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Yotpo API secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Administrator-only customer secret stored solely in Railway's encrypted credential boundary.

blocked.label: Collect Yotpo credentials
blocked.description: Relay does not collect the administrator-only API secret before representative authority and lifecycle acceptance.

blocked.label: Substitute public widget reads
blocked.description: CDN product/site review endpoints expose storefront content but do not prove account ownership, private authority, or disconnect semantics.

blocked.label: Access private Yotpo data
blocked.description: Reviews, users, orders, products, metadata, insights, media, privacy exports, and customer personal data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Mutate or use raw Yotpo APIs
blocked.description: Review creation, verification email, order/customer ingestion, metadata updates, deletion/anonymization, arbitrary endpoints, and broad pagination are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Yotpo action is enabled before customer-admin credential and entitlement acceptance.

runtimeSupport.description: No Yotpo wrappers are mounted until a representative merchant credential establishes the frozen contract.
No Yotpo wrappers are mounted until a representative merchant credential establishes the frozen contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Yotpo requires a customer administrator to reveal the Store ID and API secret, which mint a private account token without granular scopes. Public documentation shows broad review, customer/order metadata, verification-email, and privacy mutation surfaces, but no representative entitlement, token expiry, rotation, or revocation evidence is available.
providerSetup.nextAction: The exclusive provider-console and production-acceptance task should obtain authorization from a representative Yotpo merchant, provision a dedicated credential without exposing it in reports, record enabled products and token lifecycle, inspect exact schemas and quotas without external writes, and return a frozen authority contract before connector implementation.

evidence.supports: Yotpo documents the customer Store ID and administrator-only API secret used for ecommerce and third-party integrations and warns that the keys carry many privileges.
Yotpo documents client-credentials token minting from Store ID/API secret for private account APIs.
Yotpo documents merchant review reads and creation, including customer verification emails and premium-plan endpoints.
Yotpo documents private user-data checks/exports and irreversible deletion or anonymization operations.
